The adjacency algebra of a Cayley graph on a finite abelian group in characteristic p (its radical,
and semisimplicity exactly when every element of the connection set has order prime to p), the
minimal polynomial of a cycle in every characteristic, the index of the integral algebra of a cycle
in its maximal order, and the prisms that reach the bound (N + t)/2 on distinct eigenvalues
(exactly when 4 ∤ m and 6 ∤ m).

Attached: the paper (PDF), its LaTeX source with the figures as PNG, and the arXiv tarball. The
repository contains the Lean 4 certificates of every finite instance quoted in the paper (126
theorems, standard axioms only), the PARI/GP and Python checks, and the dated priority check.

Author: Deep Bhattacharjee (ORCID 0000-0003-0466-750X).
